title: Largest sparse-autoencoder dictionaries in three studies, 2023–2024, against the 512 neurons they started from
description: Bar chart on a logarithmic scale. A one-layer transformer's MLP layer had 512 neurons; Bricken et al. (October 2023) decomposed it into up to 131,072 features. Templeton et al. (May 2024) trained a dictionary of 33,554,432 features on Claude 3 Sonnet, and Gao et al. (June 2024) one of about 16 million latents on GPT-4. Sources: the three papers.
heading: FEATURES IN ONE DICTIONARY · LOG SCALE
